name: miniFORGE
limitations: No Solana mainnet mFRG mint address has been published and independently verified.
No live payment recipient, executable quote or sale authorization exists. The $0.12 rate is planning only.
The 50M supply and allocations are proposed and not verified on-chain balances.
All purchase, payment, swap, wallet signing and fulfillment actions are disabled.
Existing sandbox backend inventory limits and quote code are not production-ready for this policy.
